title: Structured Discounting Governance + Security Questionnaire Integration
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Create and operationalize a repeatable approval process and price book update flow for enterprise discounts, and embed an authoritative Security Questionnaire (SecQ) answer set into commercial onboarding. Deliverables: approval matrix, discount bands & delegated authority, price book change process, standard SecQ answer library, and Sales enablement artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Approval matrix covering up to 40% discount with clear owner for each band
Automated price-book update runbook + audit trail for sales and ops
SecQ canonical answers versioned in Confluence and linked from contract templates
Sales-facing discount request form integrated with Zendesk/Hub for tracking
Legal signoff on core contract language and data-security answers
comments: 2026-02-11 - Aisha Kaur: Kickoff with Pricing, Legal, Security. Agreed scope: discounts, price book flow, SecQ. Assigned owners: Liam (pricing), Marina (legal), Ravi (security), Devon (sales ops).

2026-02-18 - Liam Chen: First draft of discount bands uploaded to Confluence. Proposes bands: 0-10% (AE authority), 11-25% (Pricing manager sign-off), 26-40% (VP Commercial + Finance). Need Legal review on escalation clause.
2026-02-23 - Marina Ortega: Legal reviewed bands; recommended adding surtax and termination language for multi-year contracts. Flagged that discounts >30% require Finance committee memo.
2026-03-01 - Ravi Singh: Security questionnaire canonical answers initial pass completed. Marked three high-risk questions that require SOC2/SLA attachments. Action: schedule SecOps evidence handoff.
2026-03-05 - Devon Patel: Sales ops prototyped a Google Form and a Zendesk webhook to log discount requests. Workflows to be refined: auto-notify Pricing for 11%+ and Finance for 26%+.

2026-03-09 - Liam Chen: Drafted a price-book update runbook that includes preflight validation, rollback steps, and a changelog entry format. Seeking Eng support to wire a signed-off webhook to the pricing service.

2026-03-12 - Aisha Kaur: PM review. Priorities for next sprint: finalize approval matrix, Legal to produce final contract language, Eng to scope automation for price book updates, Security to attach evidence artifacts to SecQ answers.
decisions: Adopt three-tier discount authority: AE (<=10%), Pricing Manager (11-25%), VP Commercial + Finance memo (26-40%).
All price-book changes must include a changelog entry and a distribution email to Sales and Finance listservs.
Canonical SecQ answers will live in Confluence and will be exported as a signed PDF snapshot per enterprise request.
Discounts >30% will require a Finance committee memo and Legal review sign-off before counter-signature.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sales bypassing governance to close deals quickly. Mitigation: Embed soft block in CRM that requires approval for >10% discounts and training for AEs.
Risk: SecQ answers become stale. Mitigation: Quarterly review calendar owned by Security with automatic reminders and evidence attachments.
Risk: Price-book automation introduces backward-incompatible changes. Mitigation: Preflight CI checks, canary rollouts, and immediate rollback playbook.
Risk: Finance slows approvals. Mitigation: Define SLA (48 hours) for Pricing/Finance on escalations and a fallback delegation policy for time-sensitive renewals.
Risk: Legal redlines force material contract changes. Mitigation: Maintain a small set of pre-approved clause templates to shorten review cycles.
next_steps: 2026-03-15 - Legal to publish final contract template with discount escalation language
2026-03-18 - Eng to provide effort estimate for price-book webhook + audit log
2026-03-20 - Security to attach SOC2/ISO artifacts to SecQ answers and produce evidence pack
2026-03-22 - Sales ops to pilot the Zendesk flow with three AEs and capture telemetry
2026-03-25 - Cross-functional review: sign-off gate for deployment of automated price-book updates
